title: PR body claims deferred items are recorded in deferred-work.md, but the file contains no gauge-telegraph entries
evidence: PR body (_pr_body_viscomm-gauge-telegraph.md): "Deferred (deferred-work.md): the loop→feed_drop_sites call-site pin (the pre-existing debug_surface_smoke.sh class — needs a headless app-drive harness); SLA text draw-path pixel pin (app package not harness-importable; folds into the same story)." The actual file's only entries: "- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-3-2-lane-qos.md`" and "- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-routing-bandwidth-cost.md`"; `git log -1 -- _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md` → "32a1b65 story Job A: capacity-cost routing — Dijkstra over static pipe-tier costs (canon amendment 2026-08-13)" — untouched by both commits of this PR.
detail: The two deferrals have no durable record: deferred-work.md was never updated, so the committed PR artifact cross-references a record that does not exist.
recommended_fix: Append the two gauge-telegraph deferral entries to deferred-work.md (summary + evidence, matching the existing entry shape), or drop the claim from the PR body.

title: PR body verification counts don't match the shipped tree (91 vs 94 render tests, 46 vs 48 app tests; 'Roster cap 8' vs 16 slots)
evidence: PR body: "- `odin test app/render` — 91 (83 + 8 new gauge pins: table/tween/chase/ chunk/reduced-motion/pause/feed/harness-inert)" and "- `odin test app` — 46; `odin test core` — 261 (untouched)". The tree: `grep -c '^@(test)' app/render/gauge_test.odin` → 11; app/render totals 94 (83 pre-existing + 11); app totals 48 (noc_toggle 6 + pullback 16 + qos_panel 1 + settings 23 + gauge_wiring 2 = 46 + 2). Same doc line 62: "- **Roster cap 8** on the SLA ease slots" vs app/render/gauge.odin: "sla_ms:   [16]Gauge_Ease, // per-class avg-latency display (ms)".
detail: The r1 fold added 3 render tests (zombie/flash-expiry/lazy-seed) and 2 app wiring tests and widened slots 8→16, but the verification counts and the roster-cap decision line were not updated — the artifact misstates the shipped surface.
recommended_fix: Update the counts to 94 (83 + 11) and 48 (46 + 2), and restate the roster decision as 16 slots.

title: gauge_test.odin comments still describe the superseded 8-slot SLA table (slots are 16)
evidence: Line 29-30 (file header): "avg/loss mirror draw_sla_gauges's raw math; roster > 8 unfed -> //       the zero-value raw fallback)." Line 299-300: "// the ROSTER CAP: classes beyond the 8-slot table stay unfed (the // zero-value raw fallback IS the behavior — pinned by the unfed test)" — while line 301 asserts "testing.expectf(t, len(v.gauges.sla_ms) == 16, \"the SLA slot table must hold the planned roster headroom (16): got %d\", len(v.gauges.sla_ms))" and gauge.odin declares "sla_ms:   [16]Gauge_Ease,".
detail: The r1 fold changed the slot tables 8→16 but left two test comments claiming an 8-slot cap, contradicting the assertion two lines below.
recommended_fix: Update both comments (header 'roster > 8' and the '8-slot table' comment) to say 16.

title: gauge_wiring_test.odin imports the render package via ../app/render; sibling app tests use ./render
evidence: app/gauge_wiring_test.odin lines 22-24: "import \"core:testing\" / import pp \"../core\" / import rnd \"../app/render\"". Sibling tests in the same package: app/noc_toggle_test.odin line 9: "import rnd \"./render\""; app/pullback_test.odin: "import pp \"../core\" / import rnd \"./render\"".
detail: Functionally identical path, but inconsistent with the app package's own test convention; future copies propagate the odder spelling.
recommended_fix: Change to `import rnd "./render"` to match the sibling test files.
